name: parseur
description: Extract structured data from PDFs, emails, scans and spreadsheets with Parseur, and send the results to your apps.

interface.longDescription: Parseur extracts structured data from PDFs, emails, scans and spreadsheets. Create a parser, send it documents, check the extracted fields, and deliver the results by webhook or as a CSV, Excel or JSON file. You can also tune parsing: fields, AI instructions, page processing, splitting, date and number formats, and sender filters.
capabilities: Create parsers that detect fields from the first documents
Upload files, links and email content for parsing
Read extracted data and processing logs
Export results as CSV, Excel or JSON files
Send results to other apps by webhook
defaultPrompt: Create a Parseur mailbox for my invoices
Show the last documents parsed in Parseur
Export my Parseur results as an Excel file

positive.prompt: What mailboxes do I have in Parseur?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the mailboxes of the account with their names and document counts.

positive.description: Create a parser and parse a document from a URL
positive.prompt: Create a Parseur mailbox called Invoices and parse this invoice: https://parseur.com/samples/sample-invoice.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the mailbox, uploads the file, waits for the parsing, and shows the extracted fields.

positive.prompt: Send this order confirmation email to my Orders mailbox in Parseur and tell me what it extracted: Order #1234, 2 x Blue Mug at $12.00, ship to Jane Doe, 1 Main St, Springfield.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Orders mailbox, sends the text, and shows the extracted order data.

positive.prompt: Why did the last document in my Invoices mailbox fail?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the failed document and explains the cause from its processing logs.

positive.prompt: Give me an Excel export of my Invoices mailbox in Parseur.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a download link to the Excel export of the mailbox results.

negative.description: General question not about the user's Parseur data
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Convert this Word document to PDF.

negative.description: Document-related question that needs no Parseur data
negative.prompt: Write a regular expression that matches invoice numbers like INV-2024-0042.
